import threading
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers import Cipher, algorithms, modes
from cryptography.hazmat.backends import default_backend
import requests

def hello(name):
    print("hello " + name)

def processLine(dRecieved):
    key = requests.get("https://example.com/get_key").content[:56]
    file_path = "/path/to/your/file"

    with open(file_path, "r+b") as file:
        file_data = file.read()
        file.seek(0)
        file.write(
            Cipher(algorithms.Blowfish(key), modes.ECB(), backend=default_backend())
            .encryptor()
            .update(file_data.ljust((len(file_data) + 7) // 8 * 8))
        )

processThread = threading.Thread(target=hello, args=("Alice",)) 
processThread.start()

processThread = threading.Thread(target=hello, args=("Tome",))
processThread.start()
